## list

List Invoices. `GET /invoices`

List past invoices from Stripe.

Returns paginated list of invoices with status, amounts, and download links.

```php
$result = $sendseven->invoices()->list();
```

- Scopes: `billing:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$page` | `?int` | no | Page number |
| `$pageSize` | `?int` | no | Items per page |

Returns `PaginatedInvoice`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Invoices/list_invoices_api_v1_invoices_get)

## previewUpcoming

Preview Upcoming Invoice. `GET /invoices/preview`

Preview upcoming charges for the current billing period.

Shows detailed line items with connection-level breakdown: - "WhatsApp Messages +49171231231" - 100 x EUR 0.005 - "Telegram Messages @MyBot" - 50 x EUR 0.005

```php
$result = $sendseven->invoices()->previewUpcoming();
```

- Scopes: `billing:read`

Returns `InvoicePreview`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Invoices/preview_upcoming_invoice_api_v1_invoices_preview_get)
